note: Phase 1 of docs/avatar-plan.md v2 (2026-11-09): style lock on four whole characters on the figure frame (1 x 1.5 tiles, guides/figure-cut.png), right-turned three-quarter pose, painterly like the animals (barrel = camera, Cow = rendering, slice A Gertrude = proportion only). The peasant woman is also drawn dead-front as the A/B for decision D1. Two candidates each, ten images.

peasant-woman.prompt: CAMERA CONTROL: among the attached images is this game's approved BARREL cut on magenta: draw the subject from the SAME camera as that barrel (from the front, a little from above), at the same rendering and daylight (warm full daylight from high up and a little left, soft shadows only in the recesses, a soft contact shadow on the ground). RENDERING REFERENCE: the attached COW on magenta is one of this game's animals: match its rendering exactly: soft painterly, flat areas of colour with gentle shading, soft thick outlines, big plain shapes, no fine texture, no pattern, no background. The character must look like it belongs beside that cow. PROPORTION REFERENCE: the attached drawing of a young queen in a red robe on parchment is this game's approved CHARACTER PROPORTION: about four heads tall from the top of the hair to the feet, an ADULT build with a large head, roughly two and a quarter times as tall as it is wide across the sleeves. Copy ONLY its proportion: NOT its rendering (its outlines are crisper and its detail finer than this game uses now), NOT its pose, NOT its clothes. POSE: standing still, a THREE-QUARTER view: the body and the face turned a little toward the viewer's RIGHT (the character looks a little to the right of the viewer; both eyes visible; the near side of the face a little narrower; the near foot a little in front), feet slightly apart on ONE flat ground line, arms relaxed at the sides, hands open, a calm friendly expression, nothing held, nothing trailing outside the body's silhouette (no cloak tails, no bags, no staffs), clothing symmetrical left to right. SUBJECT: a young FARM WOMAN of this fairy-tale village: warm brown hair tied in a simple low bun, a plain teal-green bodice laced over a cream blouse with long sleeves, a plain rust-brown ankle-length skirt, a tan apron, simple brown shoes showing under the hem. Keep it at the game's scale: this character is seen 45 pixels wide on the board beside the barrel and the cow, so big plain shapes, no fine detail, no embroidery, no pattern, no small accessories. COLOUR: bright, saturated, cheerful; never pink, never magenta, never purple anywhere on the character. The LAST attached image is a layout guide: a pure magenta (#FF00FF) field with a thin grid, a 1 x 1 box outlined in the middle (one board tile) and a dashed half-height box directly above it (the headroom). Draw the character alone: feet on the box's bottom edge, SHOULDERS at the box's top edge, the head and hair inside the dashed headroom box (the hat may touch its top, never pass it), never past the box's left or right sides; a soft contact shadow directly under the feet; leave every other pixel pure solid magenta: no grass, no ground, no scene, no frame, no text.
